Children begin to deliberately and regularly use rehearsal, elaboration, and organization
as memory strategies by _____ years of age.
Delusions of grandeur are most characteristic of
A key accomplishment of Piaget's preoperational stage is the emergence of:

options.A: the understanding of cause and effect.
options.C: the ability to reason about abstract concepts and problems.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - the symbolic function.

questions.stem_text: Family therapy is probably contraindicated in which of the following situations?

options.A: One of the family members has severe depression.
options.B: Family members are dealing with the loss of a loved one.
options.C: Family members attribute their problems to one of the members.
options.D: The presenting problem involves sibling rivalry.
options.E: The family has recently moved to a new city.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - One of the family members has severe depression.

questions.stem_text: What is meant by the termconsciousness ?

options.A: Consciousness is the storage of genetic information in cells.
options.B: Consciousness is the ability to think
options.C: Consciousness is the ability to talk to oneself
options.D: Consciousness is the exclusive ability to solve complex mathematical problems.
options.E: Consciousness is the biological process of breathing and heartbeat regulation.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Consciousness is the storage of genetic information in cells.
